title: Say Hello
can_do_goal: I can hear and say Hello and Hi.

title: I’m Leo
can_do_goal: I can say a name with I’m.
kp_focus: I’m + name as a memorized chunk
language_focus: I’m Leo.; I’m Mia.; I’m Emma.

title: What’s Your Name?
can_do_goal: I can ask and answer a name question with help.
ai_checker: Ask or answer the name question.

title: Hi and Bye
can_do_goal: I can choose a greeting when someone comes or goes.

title: Meet the Team
can_do_goal: I can greet Leo, Mia, Emma, and Toto.
language_focus: Leo; Mia; Emma; Toto; Hello, Leo.; Hi, Mia.
ai_checker: Choose one character and greet them.

title: My Name Card
can_do_goal: I can make a simple name card.
kp_focus: Name card preparation; copied phrase I’m ___.

title: My Voice Greeting
can_do_goal: I can record a short greeting.
